scope: These four final-evaluation allocations are additions to earlier training/development experiments; no reused training cost is charged again.
Stage, action, outer driver and scheduler elapsed values are nested views and must not be added together. Across concurrent jobs summed allocation-hours are not elapsed wall time.
Scorer elapsed includes source/media validation, model/packer construction, adapter reload, scoring and postchecks; it is not pure inference throughput.

Scoring/probe allocator records stop at base loading. Full evaluation allocator peaks are unknown; external NVML/host peaks are sampled lower bounds. Preflight and outer inspections are outside the action sampler.
Legacy host validity, gaps and missing samples are preserved. RSS/PSS excludes unmapped filesystem page cache; GNU maxrss is the reported process statistic, not concurrent process-tree PSS.
Frozen references are fixed once per comparison kind/arm/split, not three trials. Per-action summaries are descriptive with no new statistical criterion.
Queue wait, local/login analysis, engineering and storage costs are separate from Slurm allocation-hours. Failed/cancelled allocations remain charged.
